title: Modules take config via Module::configure(&Section) on a Default instance, no...
rationale: Modules take config via Module::configure(&Section) on a Default instance, not constructors, because config reload must keep module state (RecentPids, app index); legacy flat keys map only in config.rs LEGACY

description: Appending [[quicklink.links]] to config.toml breaks it when the file sets links = [...] inline
resolution: Validate old text + appended text with config::parse before writing (raycast::appendix does this)

description: DEFAULT_CONFIG is an r#"..."# raw string: a `"#` sequence in comment text (e.g. "#word") ends the string early and gives dozens of confusing 'unknown prefix' errors.
resolution: Never write a double quote directly before # in DEFAULT_CONFIG comments.

description: Hex color values like "#ffcc00" in DEFAULT_CONFIG contain `"#`, which ends an r#"..."# raw string.
resolution: DEFAULT_CONFIG now uses r##"..."##; keep it, and never downgrade the delimiter.

content: Adding/renaming a module Settings field (or a new module) requires the matching commented '#key = default' line in config.example.toml; per-module the_example_config_lists_every_key tests (config::example::assert_documents compares serde field names) and src/characterization/config_example.rs fail otherwise. Setting lines are '#' + letter/'['; notes are '# '.

description: Shared::wait-style condvar waits race when the thread wakes before dropping its Arc; a waiter checks too early and sleeps out the deadline.
resolution: To wait for a thread to finish, poll Arc::strong_count(&shared) == 1 with a deadline.
